q: Hayes' theorem on the sofic entropy of algebraic actions (automorphisms of compact abelian groups) connected sofic entropy to:
opts: Fuglede-Kadison determinants of elements of the group ring ℤ[G]
exp: Hayes (building on work of Li-Thom, Deninger, Lück): the sofic entropy of the algebraic action G ↷ Ĝ_f (dual of G/f for f ∈ ℤ[G]) equals the Fuglede-Kadison logarithmic determinant log det_{L(G)}(f) when positive. This connects sofic entropy to L²-invariants (Fuglede-Kadison determinants).
